youtube.title: The Moon Is Drifting Away. Imagine It Reversed.
youtube.caption:
The real Moon is drifting away from you by about 3.8 centimeters a year. Imagine it reversing, and never stopping.

Part 1 of the Moon film: where the Moon really is, and the one number that will only ever go down.

Part 1 of 8. Full video on YouTube: How Close Can the Moon Get Before It Breaks?

Thought experiment: the Moon is not coming closer. Narration is a synthetic voice (AI); the pictures are AI-assisted paintings and code-rendered.
